DEMOLITION v1.1 — Codea (iPad)

Real material physics: glass shatters, wood splits, concrete spalls, steel bends.
TNT: 4184 J per gram (standard TNT equivalent).

1. Unzip Demolition-COPY-PASTE.zip
2. Copy Demolition.codea into Files → On My iPad → Codea
3. Open Codea → Demolition → Play

Or paste buffers in order:
  01_Materials.lua → 02_Levels.lua → 03_Main.lua

Controls: drag wrecking ball, tap TNT, RESET / NEXT.
